senses.gloss: m. (קְשַׁשׁ) [strong, hard, cmp. יָשַׁן,] old; old man, elder.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:18">Targ. Job III, 18</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 2:22">Targ. I Kings II, 22</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60b:6">B. Mets. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>אנא ק׳ מאבוך</he> I am older than thy father.
<cite ref="Yevamot 16b:6">Yeb. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>מי ק׳ כוליה האי</he> was David so very old? <cite ref="Taanit 23b:6">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>ינוקא ק׳</he> the older child.
<cite ref="Ketubot 94a:6">Keth. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>אביי ק׳</he> Abaye senior; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 142b:8">B. Bath. 142ᵇ</cite> <he>קַשִּׁישְׁנָא מינייכו</he> I am older than you.—Pl. <cite ref="S02253"><he>קַשִּׁישִׁין</he></cite>, <he>קַשִּׁישַׁיָּא</he>, <cite ref="S02251"><he>קַשִּׁישֵׁי</he></cite>, <cite ref="S02244"><he>קְשִׁ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 32:6">Targ. Job XXXII, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 12:12">Ib. XII, 12</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Horayot 11b:16">Hor. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>מי מלכי זוטרי מקמי ק׳</he> do the younger sons ascend the throne before the older? <cite ref="Berakhot 30a:16">Ber. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>רבנן ק׳ מינן</he> teachers older than we are.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:9:1">Cant. R. to VII, 9</cite> (expl. <he>הדברי</he>, <cite ref="Daniel 3:27">Dan. III, 27</cite>) <he>ק׳ ואסטרולוגיסי</he> (not <cite ref="S02251"><he>קשיש</he></cite>) elders and astrologers; a. fr.
